prompt: At night in a freight yard, a dock worker stands on a wooden cable drum addressing a crowd of workers in work jackets, seen from behind the crowd at shoulder height, everyone in dark silhouette. Behind him a row of tall yard floodlights goes dark one by one, the nearest still burning white and the far ones already black against the sky. Container trains sit on the rails at both sides. Semi-realistic painted graphic-novel comic art with heavy dark ink linework, diagonal hatching in the shadows and crosshatching in the deepest shadows, realistic painted shading and muted desaturated colour. An ordinary present-day American city. Every sign, screen and surface is blank and plain.
